who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane NJ under LANES-0445
what: Every build script was told NUM_JOBS=1, inside the keyed environment, so native scripts (librocksdb-sys and the rest of NATIVE_EVERY_MODE) compiled C and C++ one file at a time: tempo's cold check went from 170 s to 627 s, 470 s of it script time (check-g050256).
cost: a 3.7x cold regression on tempo once native scripts ran
cause: a machine hint (the job count) lived in the same type as the key's inputs, so the only safe value was a constant
whys: Env was both what the key hashes and what the child is given; a varying NUM_JOBS would have split keys by machine (rule 25), so it was pinned to 1
class: a run-only hint stored in a keyed type is either keyed (machine in the key) or frozen (slow)
prevention: done: Env::for_run(Jobs, alloc) -> RunEnv, a separate type no key takes; native runs get a command jobserver fifo (jobserver.rs) and NUM_JOBS=workers; test script_jobs_are_told_to_the_run_and_never_keyed. Owed: blaze's scheduler taking tokens for its own workers.
